text:
Elaine: Hey — quick question. I opened a small PR that removes an outdated entry from CODEOWNERS and also fixes a flaky CI test. CI passes locally but GH is blocking merge because CODEOWNERS approval is required. Does anyone know who can sign off on this? It's under infra/ci and used to be owned by the old infra-team that got archived. TL;DR: small cleanup + test fix, want to merge today.

codeowners-bot: ⚠️ This PR modifies `CODEOWNERS`. Reviews required from listed owners before merge. See: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321

Tom: If it's just removing an obsolete entry we can escalate to a current infra owner. @Jess do you have bandwidth to review/approve?

Elaine: thanks — pasted the diff below:
```diff
diff --git a/CODEOWNERS b/CODEOWNERS
@@ -12,7 +12,6 @@
 # infra team
 - /infra/legacy/ @old-infra-team
 - /infra/ci/ @sre-team
 - /infra/deploy/ @deploy-team
+
```
(only the `/infra/legacy/ @old-infra-team` line removed)

Jess: I can take a look. If the change is purely deleting a stale mapping and the test fix is unrelated to ownership, I'm fine approving. Can you confirm there are no other files moved?

Elaine: confirmed — only the one line in root CODEOWNERS and a small test tweak in `tests/flaky/test_timeout.py`. CI preview link: https://azure.preview.redwood/4321 — all green.

Rahul: Since this touches infra/ci, SRE sign-off is reasonable. @Jess your approval should be good. If anybody objects speak now. :eyes:

Jess: Approved. :thumbsup: I verified the diff and the test change looks safe. Go ahead and merge when ready.

ci-bot: ✅ Preview build passed (all checks green) — commit sha 7f3b2e4

Elaine: Thanks everyone, merging now. Will add a note to the backlog about removing stale owners and maybe add an OWNERS fallback.

Tom: Quick follow-up — can we add a short process doc so future removals don't stall? Maybe allow a single infra approver to merge deletions older than 90 days with a note.

Jess: Agree. Happy to help draft the tiny policy.

Elaine: I'll open a short RFC/PR after lunch. Thanks again!
